title: Kaneo
name: kaneo
description: Project management for teams that want to get on with the work: boards, lists, Gantt charts, labels, time tracking and GitHub, GitLab or Gitea issue sync, in workspaces you invite people into. Source: https://github.com/usekaneo/kaneo

env.name: KANEO_URL
env.label: Address you'll open it on (required)
env.description: Exactly what you'll type in the browser, port included and no slash at the end, like http://192.168.1.20:5173.

env.name: KANEO_SECRET
env.label: Secret key (required)
env.description: Signs everyone's logins. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it the same when you redeploy.

env.name: KANEO_DB_PASSWORD
env.label: Database password (required)
env.description: Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it the same when you redeploy, or Kaneo can't reach its database.

env.name: KANEO_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI
